title: First visit to /
note: Identical to the accepted first visit: focused, General 30 s. Suggested stays dashed but is now keyboard-reachable.

title: Locked Suggested pressed (0 of 10)
note: The change is cancelled; the slot explains and offers test 1. Focus stays on the key.

title: why? while baseline is 4 of 10
note: Progress, what counts, what does not, and where the count comes from.

title: Baseline test 1 ready
note: Assessment page, qwerty on, 30 s: the label names the test. First key starts it.

title: Assessment with qwerty off
note: Still a normal assessment; the slot says it will not count and how to make it count. Nothing locks.

title: Assessment at 60 s
note: Different duration: plain assessment, honest hint.

title: Test 5 of 10 complete
note: Counted after the save. next test is primary; practise and stopping are fine.

title: Test interrupted (focus lost)
note: Not counted, nothing taken away.

title: Test complete, save failed
note: Pending segment; counts once saved. Retry/export from the accepted failure row.

title: Return visit: test 5 ready
note: Resumes from saved tests. No welcome-back screen.

title: Test 10: Suggested has a focus
note: Baseline complete and a supported focus: try suggested is primary.

title: Test 10: no focus stands out
note: Baseline complete, evidence insufficient: General is primary, not a failure.

title: / after a supported focus
note: Suggested becomes an ordinary key; the remembered General stays selected.

title: Suggested · th, why?
note: Why this pair, what the block does, and the limits of the rule.

title: Complete, insufficient: why?
note: Baseline complete; no supported focus; General with a reason.

title: Complete, evidence older than 30 days
note: The milestone stays; timing is stale; one fresh assessment lets it look again.

title: Complete, recent timing not fully read
note: A read problem, not a diagnosis. check again.

title: Suggested changed th → er
note: Announced once at the next ready state; never "mastered".

title: Suggested stepped back to General
note: The remembered Suggested falls back to General with a reason.

title: 9 of 10 after a deleted test
note: The count is derived from saved tests; the panel always says so, so a deletion needs no extra memory.

title: Progress page baseline section
note: Where reset lives.

title: Start a new baseline: confirm
note: Inline confirmation, safe choice focused.

title: New baseline started
note: Non-destructive: results stay in history.

title: Storage unavailable
note: No count is shown; General works.

title: Saved tests still loading
note: No tally until the read finishes; no flicker to 0.

title: Test 10: too few finished sentences
note: The likely outcome for slow or error-prone typists: the milestone is theirs; no target is invented.

title: At least 7 of 10 (partial read)
note: Never presents an inexact count as exact.
